Based on my search, I can provide you with comprehensive information about Welch Allyn ophthalmology tools.

## Overview of Welch Allyn Ophthalmology Tools

Welch Allyn (now part of Hillrom) is a leading manufacturer of diagnostic medical equipment, including a wide range of ophthalmology tools used for eye examinations. Their products are considered a **gold standard** in clinical settings worldwide.

---

## Main Ophthalmoscope Models

Welch Allyn offers three main ophthalmoscope models:

| Feature | Traditional/Coaxial Model | Basic PanOptic | PanOptic Plus |
|---------|---------------------------|----------------|---------------|
| **Field of View** | Standard | 20× larger than standard | 20× larger than standard |
| **DuraShock Technology** | No | Yes | Yes |
| **Digital Image Capture** | No | No | Yes |
| **Quick Eye Alignment** | No | No | Yes |
| **Cobalt Blue Filter** | No | No | Yes |
| **Warranty** | 1 Year | 1 Year | 5 Years |

---

## Key Ophthalmology Products

### **1. PanOptic Plus LED Ophthalmoscope**
- **25-degree field of vision** for comprehensive retinal examination
- **Quick Eye Alignment Technology** — helps direct patient gaze for better optic disc alignment
- **DuraShock™ technology** — impact-resistant design for enhanced durability
- **Long-lasting LED lamps** — reduces need for frequent bulb replacement
- **Digital image capture capability** — for documentation and telemedicine
- Allows examination **without pupil dilation** in many cases
- Compatible with 3.5V power sources and wall transformers

### **2. PanOptic Basic LED Ophthalmoscope**
- 20× larger field of view than standard coaxial ophthalmoscopes
- Excellent optics with LED illumination
- More moderate price point than the Plus version
- Great all-around choice for general practitioners

### **3. Standard/Coaxial Ophthalmoscope**
- Traditional design with good optics
- Most cost-effective option
- Suitable for routine exams, medical students, and training programs

### **4. PocketScope LED Ophthalmoscope**
- Light, compact, and portable
- Ideal for home visits and mobile healthcare

---

## Diagnostic Sets (Combined Ophthalmology & Otology Tools)

Welch Allyn diagnostic sets typically include:

| Set Model | Ophthalmoscope | Otoscope | Power Handle | Best For |
|-----------|---------------|----------|--------------|----------|
| **71PM3LXE-US** | PanOptic Plus LED | MacroView Plus LED | Premium Li-Ion USB | Advanced, high-end exams |
| **71PM2LXU-US** | PanOptic Basic LED | MacroView Basic LED | Li-Ion Plus | Everyday use with LED |
| **71SM2LXU** | Coaxial | MacroView Basic LED | Li-Ion | Mid-range performance |
| **71SM2CXX** | Coaxial | MacroView Basic LED | NiCad | Budget-conscious practices |
| **71SS2CXX** | Standard | Standard | NiCad | Entry-level/basic needs |

---

## Additional Ophthalmology Tools

- **Retinoscopes** — for determining refractive errors (myopia, hyperopia, astigmatism)
- **iExaminer Pro App** — digital platform for capturing, saving, and sharing eye images
- **iExaminer Smart Bracket** — smartphone adapter for digital otoscopy/ophthalmoscopy
- **Various filters and apertures:**
  - Red filter — for examining blood vessels
  - Cobalt blue filter — for corneal abrasions/ulcers with fluorescein dye
  - Slit apertures — for contour abnormalities of cornea, lens, or retina
  - Grids — for measuring retinal lesions

---

## Common Clinical Applications

- **Fundoscopic examination** — viewing the retina, optic disc, and blood vessels
- **Detection of systemic diseases** — diabetes, hypertension, neurological conditions affecting small blood vessels
- **Corneal assessment** — abrasions, ulcers, foreign bodies
- **Glaucoma screening** — optic disc evaluation
- **Pediatric eye exams** — especially with wide-view PanOptic models
- **Telemedicine/remote consultations** — using digital capture features

---

## Power Options

- **Premium Lithium-Ion USB Rechargeable Handles** — longest battery life, USB charging
- **Lithium-Ion Plus Handles** — extended battery life, lightweight
- **Nickel-Cadmium (NiCad) Rechargeable Handles** — dependable but shorter battery life, heavier
- **3.5V power sources** and wall transformers for stationary use

---

Sources:
1. https://cornellsurgical.com/blogs/default-blog/diagnostic-sets-full-comparison-guide?srsltid=AfmBOoo4v6VqZXjP17gIZf2Ctnqd5sYHYv2s3MhRNNz9N6DVINtEPvua
2. https://www.dispomed.com/welch-allyn-ophthalmoscope-purchase-guide/
3. https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/ophthalmic-sets/
4. https://www.techsciresearch.com/blog/product-review-new-welch-allyn-panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope-and-welch-allyn-macroview-plus-otoscope/213.html
5. https://www.medshop.com.au/blogs/news/what-is-a-welch-allyn-ophthalmoscope-amp-how-to-use-one?srsltid=AfmBOor2m8RV4NJXDNlfe-IXyseliDKn98LZkiG9FNWXnRNuwS2l6x7L
6. https://www.lepekemedical.com/post/product-review-welch-allyn-3-5v-diagnostic-set
